title: Vertex AI Search — Public Pattern 3
description: Template schema for deploying a public Vertex AI Search (Discovery Engine) Data Store and Search Engine with Cloud Storage document staging.

region.description: GCP region for regional resources (GCS staging bucket).

display_name.description: Display name prefix for search resources.

data_store_id.description: Unique ID for the Discovery Engine Data Store.

content_config.description: Content storage configuration for unstructured documents.

create_search_engine.description: Whether to deploy a search engine linked to the data store.

engine_id.description: Optional search engine ID (defaults to data_store_id-engine).

search_add_ons.description: Enabled add-on features (e.g. SEARCH_ADD_ON_LLM for generative summaries).

create_staging_bucket.description: Whether to create a Cloud Storage staging bucket for document uploads.

staging_bucket_name.description: Custom name for document staging bucket.
